notify.access_denied.title: Notification access is not granted

notify.config_invalid.title: Could not read the config
notify.config_reloaded.title: Config reloaded
notify.config_reloaded.body: The edited config has been applied.
notify.test.title: Test notification

notify.steamvr_unregister_partial.title: SteamVR unregistration stopped partway
notify.steamvr_unregister_partial.body: Auto-launch has been disabled, but removing the vrmanifest registration failed, so the app is still registered on the SteamVR side.
settings.general.language_note: Language changes take effect on the next launch.
settings.defaults.note: Icon accepts app / default / warning / error, or a path to a PNG file. Sound accepts default / warning / error, or a path to an audio file; leave it empty to mute.
settings.rules.apply_observed: Use the selected app_id as the condition
settings.rules.filter_apps: Target app_id (one per line, prefix match)

settings.dialog.saved_body: The settings were saved and applied.
settings.dialog.unsaved_body: There are unsaved changes. Press Close again to discard them, or press Save to keep them.
settings.external_change: The config file has changed on disk. Saving your edits will overwrite it.
notify.update_available.title: A new version is available
notify.update_available.body: {version} has been released. You can download it from the tray menu or the About tab.
notify.update_none.title: No updates
notify.update_none.body: You are running the latest version.
settings.general.update_check: Check for updates at startup and once a day
settings.about.update_latest: You are running the latest version
settings.about.update_unchecked: Updates have not been checked yet
notify.update_failed.title: Could not check for updates
notify.update_failed.body: Could not fetch the release list from GitHub. Check your connection.
notify.update_unsure.title: Could not confirm the latest version
notify.update_unsure.body: There are too many releases to list fully. Check the release page directly.
settings.about.update_unsure: Could not confirm whether this is the latest version
notify.update_downloading.title: Started downloading the update
notify.update_downloading.body: Downloading {version}. You will be notified when it is ready.
notify.update_downloaded.title: The update is ready
notify.update_downloaded.body: {version} will be applied the next time the app starts. To swap it now, choose it from the tray menu.
notify.update_download_failed.title: Could not download the update
notify.update_download_failed.body: Could not fetch the asset from GitHub. Check your connection, or download it from the release page.
notify.update_no_asset.title: The update cannot be downloaded
notify.update_no_asset.body: This release has no executable attached. Download it from the release page.
notify.update_apply_failed.title: Could not apply the update
notify.update_apply_failed.body: Could not replace the executable. Download it again and retry.
settings.about.update_staged: Ready: {version} (will be applied on the next start)
notify.update_available.body_release_pag: {version} has been released. Open the release page from the About tab.
notify.update_broken.title: The executable is missing from its original path
notify.update_broken.body: The replacement failed and the saved executable could not be restored. Recovery steps have been written to the log.
notify.update_relaunch_failed.title: The update was applied
notify.update_relaunch_failed.body: The executable was replaced but could not be relaunched. The new version will run the next time you start the app.
settings.dialog.update_unsaved_body: Applying the update restarts the app. Save your changes or close the settings window, then press the button again.
